title: MCP tool entry
description: One object in the 'tools' array of the 'mcp_tools' state document (/config/mcp_tools.json). Entries are produced by MCP discovery; the only field an edit may change is 'enabled'.

name.description: Prefixed tool name the agent sees, '<server>_<original_name>' (e.g. 'jina_search_jina_blog'). Discovery-owned.

server.description: Name of the MCP server (key under 'mcpServers' in /config/mcp.json) that exposes this tool. Discovery-owned.

original_name.description: The tool's name as the MCP server reports it. Discovery-owned.

description.description: The tool's description as the MCP server reports it. Discovery-owned.

enabled.description: Whether the agent may use this tool. false disables just this tool while its server stays connected; it stays listed (and toggleable) on the Tools page and survives re-discovery.
